name: c8-slots

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 8 --kv-tokens 2097152 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: record + diff drafted 8 slots == serial 4 slots

commands: python3 bench/tools/bench.py --url http://node-4:8000 --model inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --max-model-len 262144 --phases warm,decode,conc,rolling --raw --out PASS.json (4 passes, first discarded)
SLOTS=8 SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=on VISION=on ./inkling2mini.sh start; same passes
python3 bench/tools/exactness.py record exactness-8slots-drafted.json; python3 bench/tools/exactness.py diff exactness-B-serial.json exactness-8slots-drafted.json
notes: 8 slots accepted with the drafter, the prefix cache and vision; no refusal. c=8 steady is computed from the per-request wall times (see README). Eight rolling workers: not measurable, bench.py has no flag (tool not edited). The memwatch figures are the guard's window minima read after each configuration. GPU clock locked at 2200 MHz (reads 2197).
